— 01 / The Building & The Apartment

A considered building, and a furnished apartment ready to be lived in.

Solid construction, controlled access, a quiet family-oriented community — and inside, a fully furnished two-bedroom that opens onto its terrace. Move-in ready, whether you're buying or settling in for a long stay.

01

Fully furnished, move-in ready

The apartment is sold or rented furnished — kitchen equipped, beds made, living room set. No second trip to a furniture warehouse before you can occupy it.

02

Living room opens entirely to the terrace

The full living-room wall opens onto the terrace, dissolving the line between inside and outside. One of the bedrooms also has direct terrace access — useful in the cooler months when you want the doors open and the sea air in.

03

European-quality windows

The window and door joinery is high European specification — relevant for thermal performance, acoustic insulation, and long-term durability in the Cabo climate.

04

Architecture by Agustín Landa

The building is the work of the respected Mexican architect — proportion, daylight, and material honesty over surface decoration.

05

Solid construction

Well-built. Intended for long-term residence rather than transient occupancy — and it shows in the finishes, the walls, and the silence between units.

06

Gated entry & CCTV · family-oriented

Controlled access, closed-circuit monitoring, and a residential rhythm rather than a resort one. Real considerations for families and part-time residents.

— 02 / The Lifestyle

Quietly central. Surrounded by what matters.

Ladera San José sits in the Cerro Colorado corridor — beach, shops, healthcare, schools, and golf all within minutes of the door, yet evenings stay calm.

i.

Beach & shops, across the highway

Palmilla beach and the shopping center sit just on the other side of the Transpeninsular — about seven minutes from the door. Daily groceries, a quick swim, an early dinner — all close.

Distance ≈ 7 min
ii.

Three golf courses, close at hand

Palmilla, Querencia, and El Dorado — all within minutes of the front door. Well-known names in the corridor, useful whether or not you play.

Tee Times 03 courses
iii.

Premium healthcare

Immediate access to H+ Hospital — a state-of-the-art facility offering peace of mind for retirees, families, and long-stay residents.

Walking Distance H+ Hospital
iv.

Top education

Seamless access to Picacho McGregor, one of the region's most highly regarded schools — a quiet but decisive factor for resident families.

Anchor School Picacho McGregor
View from the residence
— 03 / The Outdoors

The terrace, extended.

The living room opens entirely onto the terrace — one continuous room when the doors are folded back. One of the bedrooms also has direct terrace access, useful in the cooler months. Upper-floor balconies pick up a line of sight to the Sea of Cortez, and the lower-level terrace sits against a natural rock face for shade and quiet.

— Setting

Hillside architecture, desert composure.

Agustín Landa's building reads the topography of Cerro Colorado rather than fighting it. Warm rendered façades, deep-set balconies, and earth-tone framing settle the structure into its corridor — close enough to the highway for ease, removed enough to keep its quiet.

— 04 / The Upside

Steady appreciation, supported by what's coming next.

The Cerro Colorado corridor is in sustained, measured growth. Buying into the existing building means inheriting the value lift of three near-term developments.

i

Phase II in development

Already in the works. Historically, Phase II announcements drive measurable price appreciation in Phase I units across the corridor.

ii

New shopping center

A brand-new retail hub is under construction nearby — bringing daily convenience and desirability to the immediate catchment.

iii

Residents' Club House

A future on-site Club House is planned, intended to round out the development's shared amenities for residents.

— 05 / The Plan

The two-bedroom layout, in full.

1,354 sqft (≈126 m²) of considered interior, built in 2022 and delivered fully furnished. The living room opens entirely onto an L-shaped terrace via folding doors. Two bedrooms — one with its own direct terrace access. Two full en-suite bathrooms, plus a guest bathroom (powder room) for visitors. European-quality windows throughout. Generous closet runs. Designed so daily flow stays gentle, and so guests can stay longer without anyone feeling on top of each other.
